summarize_config: summarize the TinyViT-5m model configuration dictionary for ImageClassifier backbone and head settings
review_model_config: review the TinyViT-5m model config to check backbone arch window size and head parameters
build_tinyvit_classifier: build an ImageClassifier using the TinyViT-5m backbone config with 1000 class LinearClsHead
refactor_model_config: refactor the TinyViT-5m model config to change img_size drop_path_rate or num_classes
test_model_config: test the TinyViT-5m model configuration by instantiating the ImageClassifier with the provided dict
